data.text:
A wave of excitement surrounded the launch of Burj Azizi with the sale of an astounding AED 63 million penthouse among the first properties to be claimed on day one. This record-breaking transaction cements the tower's status as one of the most exclusive and sought-after addresses in the city.

Here's everything you need to know about the Dh63 million penthouse in Dubai!

Burj Azizi Observed Record-Breaking Sales on Launch Day

Demand for Burj Azizi penthouse units was staggering, with over 110 apartments sold on the first day. Buyers flocked to secure their place in this landmark development, with transactions reaching multimillion figures in mere minutes.

One of the standout sales was the whopping AED 63 million penthouse, highlighting the immense demand for ultra-luxury residences.

The penthouse sold is located on the 88th floor. This ultra-luxurious unit boasts a private steam room, sauna, and an exclusive swimming pool, offering an unmatched living experience.

Sales were simultaneously launched in seven cities worldwide, with Dubai’s event hosted at Conrad Hotel on Sheikh Zayed Road. Throughout the day, prospective buyers and investors streamed in, eager to be part of what is expected to be a defining skyscraper in the golden city's skyline.

data.text:
Burj Azizi Penthouse Price and Features

Curious about the Burj Azizi penthouse price and features? We've got the inside scoop for you!

With prices starting at AED 7.5 million and reaching an astonishing AED 156 million, the Burj Azizi penthouses offer an unparalleled level of sophistication and grandeur.

Each penthouse in Burj Azizi is crafted with meticulous attention to detail and features:

  • Expansive layouts offering spacious living areas
  • Floor-to-ceiling windows with breathtaking skyline views
  • State-of-the-art smart home automation
  • World-class interiors with high-end fittings
  • Private amenities such as dedicated elevators
  • Rooftop terraces providing exclusive outdoor spaces
  • Infinity pools available in select units

What to Expect From the World's Second Tallest Tower?

Burj Azizi will rise to an astounding height of 725 meters on Sheikh Zayed Road. The development consists of 1,037 high-end luxury residences, including Burj Azizi penthouses.

A total of 128 Burj Azizi penthouses showcase the pinnacle of luxury, spread across eight floors. Described as a ‘city within a city,’ the tower is designed to offer residents a self-sufficient luxury lifestyle.

It will feature an extensive list of world-class amenities, including:

  • The highest hotel lobby in the world on level 111
  • The highest nightclub on level 126
  • The highest restaurant on level 122
  • A hotel room on level 118
  • A state-of-the-art cinema, a supermarket, and a luxury hotel
  • A dedicated museum at the top of the tower, showcasing the evolution of the building with multimedia exhibits
  • A business center, games room, gym, yoga studio, spa, kids’ play area, fine dining restaurants, and coffee shops

In addition, a 360-degree observation deck will offer breathtaking views of Dubai, while a high-end retail space will house exclusive boutiques and invite-only brands.

faqs.question: What makes the Dh63 million penthouse in Dubai unique?

data.answer: The Dh63 million penthouse in Dubai stands out due to its private steam room, sauna, and swimming pool, along with expansive living spaces offering unmatched luxury and breathtaking views from the 88th floor of Burj Azizi.

faqs.question: How many penthouses are available in Burj Azizi?

data.answer: Burj Azizi features 128 penthouses across eight floors, with units ranging from 1-bedroom to ultra-luxurious 3-bedroom penthouses.

faqs.question: What is the starting price of a Burj Azizi penthouse?

data.answer: The Burj Azizi penthouse price and features start at AED 7.5 million, with the most exclusive units reaching up to AED 156 million.

faqs.question: When will Burj Azizi be completed?

data.answer: Burj Azizi is expected to be completed in 2028, offering a full suite of luxury amenities and world-record-breaking features.

faqs.question: What amenities does Burj Azizi offer to residents?

data.answer: Residents of Burj Azizi will have access to a cinema, hotel, high-end retail boutiques, a gym, spa, yoga studio, kids’ play area, and some of the world’s highest entertainment and hospitality venues.
